summary:
Junior Astronaut – Mission Trainer is an interactive 2D educational space adventure designed for children aged 7–12. Players become junior astronauts responsible for managing lunar and Martian outposts through engaging stories, missions and engineering challenges.

The game teaches how real spacecraft systems work, including oxygen supply, ventilation, electrical power, water recycling, radiation protection and food production. Through interactive learning cards and problem-solving missions, players identify equipment failures, make critical decisions and experience the consequences.

Its core feature is a resource-management system where every decision involves trade-offs. Saving power for one system may affect another, teaching players how astronauts and mission planners balance competing priorities.

With progressive difficulty, recurring challenges, mission rewards, boss levels and guidance from Captain Nova, the game combines entertainment with meaningful scientific learning.

Where practical, it incorporates NASA open data, including space-weather information from DONKI, while clearly distinguishing real observations from simulated gameplay.

Our goal is to make space engineering understandable, exciting and accessible to the next generation of explorers.
